 About the match
 On this page you can find the CF America vs Toluca match lineup for Liga MX — Round 15 - First Leg, on Sunday 01-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. CF America lines up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Henry, while Toluca sets up in a 4-2-3-1 led by Gallardo. CF America is led by head coach Guillermo Almada, while Toluca is managed by Antonio Mohamed. The match is played at Estadio Banorte.
